incident.name: Sony Pictures Hack
incident.description: Destructive attack wiped Sony's network, leaked unreleased films, executive emails, and employee PII. Politically motivated.
incident.lessons: Insider threat programs and data classification are critical for media companies.

relatedIncidents.name: WannaCry Ransomware
relatedIncidents.description: Global ransomware attack exploiting NSA's EternalBlue SMB exploit. Hit 150+ countries, crippled UK NHS.
relatedIncidents.lessons: Patch management and network segmentation are non-negotiable.

relatedIncidents.name: Lazarus Group Bangladesh Bank Heist
relatedIncidents.description: $81M stolen from Bangladesh Bank via fraudulent SWIFT messages. $951M attempted. Exploited weak SWIFT security controls.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Weak SWIFT security controls, no anomaly detection on transactions
relatedIncidents.lessons: Financial transaction monitoring and SWIFT security controls are critical.

relatedIncidents.name: 3CX Supply Chain Attack
relatedIncidents.description: Lazarus Group compromised 3CX VoIP software via a prior supply chain attack on Trading Technologies. First known supply chain attack via supply chain.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Cascading supply chain compromise, insufficient binary signing verification
relatedIncidents.lessons: Supply chain attacks can cascade. SBOM and reproducible builds are essential.
